thread:
jordan: Quick q from the all-hands — can someone clarify the new release cadence? I heard we were moving from monthly to biweekly?
liam: Good question. We're moving to a 3-week cadence for routine minor releases and keeping a monthly cadence for major releases. Goal is predictable windows for teams and customers.
ana: Is the requirement for feature flags still in place for user-facing changes? e.g., all non-trivial features behind a flag until validated? :thinking_face:
mike: Short answer: yes. All user-facing changes should be behind a feature flag or deployed as a canary for at least one full business day. Infra/ops fixes are the usual exception.
sara: Who owns the canary/runbook and who needs to be notified? Support/oncall needs heads-up for potential customer impact.
liam: Eng leads own rollout policies. Ops-oncall should be notified 24h before any scheduled canary and again 2h before a production ramp. We'll add exact notif hooks to the playbook.
ops-oncall: To confirm — notification should be a slack ping + post in #incidents? current oncall process prefers slack mention and a brief pager if changes touch routing or auth.
emily: On quality bars — what are the measurable thresholds we need before promoting? p99/perf/latency thresholds?
mike: Quality bars we're aligning on: unit/integration tests green, e2e smoke pass in staging, and no P99 regressions >10% vs baseline without mitigations. Any rollback triggers listed in the checklist.
jordan: And the SLA story — will hosted API SLAs change with this cadence? customers have been asking.
liam: No SLA changes planned for hosted. Dedicated customers keep contractual SLAs. Internally we'll start surfacing per-route SLO dashboards (30/90d baselines) so PMs and Eng leads can see trends before a release.
ana: Can someone produce a short doc that summarizes the cadence, the checklist, and notification flow? happy to help draft.
dev-rel-bot: Recording + notes uploaded: https://redwood-internal/notes/1801234567 — includes the slide with rollout checklist and links to the playbook.
jordan: Can we add a small retrospective cadence for teams after each release? several teams asked for a 15m sync to capture regressions and follow-ups.
liam: Yes — adding a 15m release retro as optional but recommended. I'll open a PR to the handbook with the updated cadence, checklist, and oncall notif flow by EOD Thursday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ana: Thanks — once PR is up I'll loop in docs to surface the checklist in the public runbook.
mike: Quick deploy helper for canaries (example):
```
/deploy --service api --canary 10% --notify ops-oncall
```
mike: Please use the tool above to standardize canary ops. If you have exceptions, flag them in the PR.
